items.title: Dropping a runtime from async code panics: "Cannot drop a runtime in a context where blocking is not allowed"
items.excerpt: I'm dropping a tokio runtime inside an async function and it panics. … Is there a way to shut it down without blocking?

items.title: Dropping a runtime from async code panics: "Cannot drop a runtime in a context where blocking is not allowed"
items.excerpt: Use Runtime::shutdown_background instead of dropping the runtime in an async context, or move the drop to a blocking thread with spawn_blocking.

items.title: How do I share one tokio runtime between libraries?
items.excerpt: My library creates its own runtime but the application already has one … what is the idiomatic way to pass a handle?

items.title: Tokio panics with 'there is no reactor running'
items.excerpt: Wrap the call in Runtime::enter or spawn it on the runtime before using the timer.
